body:
Current agreed source identity and EO credit. Use the one Engram-owned source_id contract; delivery/build status belongs on its work items, not in this memory. Git root/submodule commits and the hashes of locally changed files describe one source state; local changes are not a separate mode. Use existing Git status/diff, not a whole-repository file/index list, watcher events or hashing/comparing the .git directory. Ignored paths stay excluded. Unavailable or partial capture never becomes a complete identity. Keep the accepted Git visibility limits, including reverted changes between captures and changes Git does not report.

Greg via Asistant#406 (2026-11-06), verbatim: „NIE, source_id opisuje stan zrodel, czyli commity git + hashe lokalnie zmienionych plikow mamy jeden mechanizm na wszystko TAK ? to jest moja propozycja ktora probuje wymusic od paru dni”. Asistant#396: „ŻADNEGO hashowania katalogu .git”. Asistant#402: „NIE ... PO TO MAMY SOURCE_ID ktory rozwiazuje te problemy wszyscy maja uzywac tylko source_id”.

Agreed native credit: a host-observed declared command as the turn's first tool action; its valid declared result artifact supplies the verdict; full source_id before == after, dirty allowed; existing project/store/item/claim/root/run identity and completion-obligation guards. No watcher or other non-agreed credit condition. Greg via Asistant#418: „to jest wystarczajacy warunek ... mysle, ze i tak jest za silny, ale zacznijmy od tego”. Detailed binding and verdict semantics remain with the existing owner and agreed definition (rules-greg-no-credit-blocking-rules-2026-11-07). This is the agreed target, not an independently verified claim about every installed consumer. Preserve existing evaluations and seals; content-v1 retirement and evaluation re-enable follow their own current decisions.

2026-11-21, Greg directly in Engram::Inquisitor (session-19238), verbatim: „NIE NIE NIE NIE

korwa NIE

po to termal ma source_id ABY TEGO W JEDNOLITY SPOSOB UZYWAC”. This explicitly applies the existing single Engram-owned source_id to review in TermAl and Comovo. An explicit Git base and commit select the diff scope; `git diff --submodule=diff` is how to display that scope. Neither is a second review identity. Use the existing producer and stop whole-repository file hashing on ordinary review paths.
